pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/Composer.tsx:4 A follow-up typed while Athena is working either interrupts the running turn (supersede-and-restart) or waits until the turn ends. It is never injected additively at a model-call boundary, which is the design the technique names as the one that loses.

techniques.evidence: src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/Composer.tsx:63 sendOrQueue (athenaChatQueue.ts:36-43) sorts each mid-turn message. A 'redirect' calls interrupt() and then re-sends as a new turn, which is supersede. An 'additive' or ambiguous message is queued and sent only after the turn completes (lines 55-63), one per completion. No path injects at the call boundary.
